en: For the conductor with stringed music, a psalm of Asaf, a song.

he: נוֹדָ֣ע בִּיהוּדָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גָּד֥וֹל שְׁמֽוֹ׃
en: Known in Yehudah is Elokim; in Yisrael great is His name.
In Shalem was His booth; His dwelling in Tzion.

he: שָׁ֭מָּה שִׁבַּ֣ר רִשְׁפֵי־קָ֑שֶׁת מָגֵ֬ן וְחֶ֖רֶב וּמִלְחָמָ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
en: There He broke the flaming arrows of the bow — shield and sword and battle. Selah.
Radiant are You, glorious, from the mountains of prey.

he: אֶשְׁתּֽוֹלְל֨וּ ׀ אַבִּ֣ירֵי לֵ֭ב נָמ֣וּ שְׁנָתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־מָצְא֖וּ כׇל־אַנְשֵׁי־חַ֣יִל יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
en: The stout of heart were despoiled; they slept their sleep; all the men of valor found not their hands.

he: מִ֭גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב נִ֝רְדָּ֗ם וְרֶ֣כֶב וָסֽוּס׃
en: From Your rebuke, Elokim of Yackov — both chariot and horse slumbered.

he: אַתָּ֤ה ׀ נ֥וֹרָא אַ֗תָּה וּמִֽי־יַעֲמֹ֥ד לְפָנֶ֗יךָ מֵאָ֥ז אַפֶּֽךָ׃
en: You — awesome are You; who can stand before You when You are angry?

he: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַ֣עְתָּ דִּ֑ין אֶ֖רֶץ יָֽרְאָ֣ה וְשָׁקָֽטָה׃
en: From heaven You proclaimed judgment; the earth feared and was still.
When Elokim rose for judgment — to save all the humble of the earth. Selah.

he: כִּֽי־חֲמַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם תּוֹדֶ֑ךָּ שְׁאֵרִ֖ית חֵמֹ֣ת תַּחְגֹּֽר׃
en: For the wrath of man shall praise You; the remnant of wrath You shall gird.

he: נִ֥דְר֣וּ וְשַׁלְּמוּ֮ לַיהֹוָ֢ה אֱֽלֹהֵ֫יכֶ֥ם כׇּל־סְבִיבָ֑יו יֹבִ֥ילוּ שַׁ֝֗י לַמּוֹרָֽא׃
en: Vow and pay to Havayah your Elokim — all around Him bring tribute to the Awesome One.
He cuts off the spirit of princes; He is awesome to the kings of the earth.
